generatedNote: Real Fam Jam S3 tastemaker (discoverability v2) data exported from the league DB for Concept-C visual mockups. Cumulative through round 101 (the season finale = whole season). Static snapshot, not a live feed.

scoring.obscurity: 100 - popularity_proxy (Last.fm log-normalized listeners+playcount over the full corpus, 0-100)
scoring.discoveryPercentile: rank of a song's obscurity across the season's scored songs, 0-100 (de-squashes the bunched scale)
scoring.tastemakerScore: MEDIAN of a player's songs' discoveryPercentile (median resists a single mainstream outlier)
scoring.buckets: on RAW obscurity: radioHit <10, recognizable 10-19, curiousCut 20-29, rabbitHole 30+
scoring.prevRank: rank recomputed over the corpus through the prior round (round-over-round)
